definition.def: Something that is brief lasts for only a short time.
examples: She once made a brief appearance on television.
This time their visit is brief.

definition.def: A brief speech or piece of writing does not contain too many words or details.
examples: In a brief statement, he concentrated entirely on international affairs.
Write a very brief description of a typical problem.

definition.def: If you are brief, you say what you want to say in as few words as possible.
examples: Now please be brief–my time is valuable.
I hope to be brief and to the point.

definition.def: You can describe a period of time as brief if you want to emphasize that it is very short. [emphasis]
examples: For a few brief minutes we forgot the anxiety and anguish.

definition.def: Men's or women's underpants can be referred to as briefs.
examples: A bra and a pair of briefs lay on the floor.

definition.def: If someone briefs you, especially about a piece of work or a serious matter, they give you information that you need before you do it or consider it.
examples: A department spokesperson briefed reporters. [VERB noun]
The Prime Minister has been briefed by her parliamentary aides. [be VERB-ed + by]

definition.def: If someone gives you a brief, they officially give you responsibility for dealing with a particular thing. [mainly British, formal]
examples: She joined the company less than two years ago with a brief to turn the studio around.

definition.def: You can say in brief to indicate that you are about to say something in as few words as possible or to give a summary of what you have just said.
If you refer to something in brief, you are referring to a shortened version of it with few details.
If someone, especially a politician, briefs against another person, he or she tries to harm the other person's reputation by saying something unfavourable about them. [British]
examples: Ministerial colleagues were briefing against him. [VERB PARTICLE noun]

examples.sentence: You can't brief people just by saying, "We're going in this direction and I'm going to take you with me."
